findings.current: Mu Song, who had been dragged all the way to Hubei Province under the guise of compulsory volunteer work, trembled with emotion.
findings.defect: “Under the guise” adds an element of deception absent from the source and weakens the oxymoronic joke that his contribution of talent was compulsory.
findings.rationale: 강제적인 재능기부 directly describes a coerced donation of talent, not coercion concealed behind a pretext.
findings.replacement: Mu Song, who had been forced into volunteering his talents all the way to Hubei Province, trembled with emotion.
findings.source: 강제적인 재능기부로 호북성까지 오게 된 무송은 감격으로 몸을 부르르 떨었다.

findings.current: He stared at the suddenly empty harbor with a deeply furrowed brow, then called over one of his trusted subordinates.
findings.defect: The draft reduces Mu Song’s right-hand man to merely a trusted subordinate, losing the subordinate’s specific status in the hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 오른팔 격인 explicitly identifies the subordinate as the equivalent of Mu Song’s right arm.
findings.replacement: He stared at the suddenly empty harbor with a deeply furrowed brow, then called over his right-hand man.
findings.source: 미간을 좁힌 채 순식간에 텅 빈 항구를 바라보던 그가 오른팔 격인 수하를 불렀다.

findings.current: At last, Jeok Cheongang—the Fire Pokémon who had escaped the water—wore a bright smile across his face.
findings.defect: The draft replaces the Pokémon type-matchup joke with a literal escape from water, omitting the gaming concept expressed by 상성.
findings.rationale: 상성 refers to compatibility or matchup, making Jeok Cheongang’s problem a Fire Pokémon’s unfavorable type matchup rather than merely his physical location on water.
findings.replacement: At last, Jeok Cheongang—the Fire Pokémon finally free of his type disadvantage—wore a bright smile across his face.
findings.source: 드디어 상성 지역에서 벗어난 불 포켓몬, 적천강의 만면에 환한 웃음이 서렸다.

findings.defect: Jeok Cheongang is mocking the official’s imperious speech endings, but the draft instead repeats pieces of the official’s factual question and loses the register-based intimidation.
findings.rationale: 하거라 and 못할까 echo the official’s condescending commands and rhetorical demand; Jeok Cheongang is pointedly repeating that register back to him.

findings.current: The spearpoints of the government troops surrounding us trembled.
findings.defect: The official’s own startled reaction is omitted.
findings.rationale: 관리는 물론이고 explicitly includes the official alongside the trembling spearpoints.
findings.replacement: The official flinched, and the spearpoints of the government troops surrounding us trembled as well.
findings.source: 관리는 물론이고 우리를 둘러싼 관군들의 창끝이 움찔 떨렸다.

findings.current: Judging by your robes, you are a sixth-rank judicial official.
findings.defect: The draft omits the secondary grade within the sixth rank and generalizes the specific office of 이문 into an unspecified judicial position.
findings.rationale: 종육품 specifies the secondary sixth rank, while 이문 is the official’s particular judicial title.
findings.replacement: Judging by your robes, you are a Judicial Inquirer of the secondary sixth rank.

findings.current: “Oh, by the way. Do you know someone here whose personal name is Hongcheon?”
findings.defect: The draft misreads 이 가 as “here,” erasing the person’s surname and changing his identity.
findings.rationale: 이 가 means a person of the Yi family, while 홍천 is his given name.
findings.replacement: “Oh, by the way. Do you know a man surnamed Yi whose given name is Hongcheon?”
findings.source: “아, 그건 그렇고 이 가에 홍천이라는 함자를 쓰시는 분을 알고 계시오?”

findings.current: “With a heart as vast as the sea, this insignificant one can only be grateful!”
findings.defect: The draft omits the official’s surname, Son, replacing his self-identification with a generic deferential expression.
findings.rationale: 이 손 모 identifies the speaker as a certain man surnamed Son; it is not merely a humble first-person pronoun.
findings.replacement: “This man Son can only be deeply grateful for your heart as vast as the sea!”
findings.source: “대해와도 같은 마음씨에 이 손 모, 감읍할 따름입니다!”

findings.current: If he could say something like that with such confidence, he must have sown quite a few seeds.
findings.defect: The literal seed metaphor is ambiguous in English and can suggest fathering children rather than cultivating useful relationships.
findings.rationale: 뿌려 놓은 씨앗 metaphorically refers to the political and personal connections Jin Wikyung has established.
findings.replacement: If he could say something like that with such confidence, he must have cultivated quite a few connections.
findings.source: 이렇게까지 말할 정도면 뿌려 놓은 씨앗이 상당한 모양이다.

findings.current: Written in cloud-like calligraphy across the pure-white silk martial robes they wore were three words:
findings.defect: “Three words” is an unsupported addition and is also inconsistent with the two-word English rendering that follows.
findings.rationale: The source only says that the following name was written on the robes; it gives no word or character count.
findings.replacement: Written in cloud-like calligraphy across the pure-white silk martial robes they wore was:
findings.source: 그들이 걸친 새하얀 비단 무복에는 구름 같은 글씨체로 이렇게 쓰여 있었다.

summary: One critical identity error, several meaningful omissions of hierarchy, register, and characterization, and localized terminology and wording issues.
